title: Unit comparison components on K-flat representatives
statement: Let every scheme X [def-pc-scheme] have a chosen derived category D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. For every morphism f:X→Y let T_f be the additive tensor pullback pinned by the adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let L_f be derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Write Q_X for the localization from the homotopy category of O_X-module cochain complexes, and T_f^h for the functor induced by T_f on homotopy categories. Choose natural transformations ε_f:Q_Y⋙L_f→T_f^h⋙Q_X making L_f a left derived functor; assume their components on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] are invertible. For each composable f:X→Y and g:Y→Z choose c(f,g):L_g⋙L_f≅L_(f≫g) such that its hom is the left-derived lift of the two successive counits followed by Q_X applied to the homotopy-category composition comparison. This underived comparison is the adjunction conjugate of pushforwardComp(f,g)^(-1), using exactly the pinned adjunctions Classical.choose of exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction. All functor reassociations in this lift are the canonical associators. For each X let t_X:T_(id_X)≅id be leftAdjointIdIso of the pinned adjunction and pushforwardId X. Let t_X^h:T_(id_X)^h≅id be its homotopy image followed by mapHomotopyCategoryIdIso. Suppose i(X):L_(id_X)≅id satisfies whiskerLeft Q_X i(X).hom followed by the right unitor = ε_(id_X) followed by whiskerRight (t_X^h).hom Q_X and the left unitor. For every f:X→Y and every K-flat complex P of O_Y-modules, the following two natural transformations have equal components at Q_Y(P): the hom of c(id_X,f) followed by transport along id_comp f equals the hom of whiskerLeft L_f i(X) followed by rightUnitor L_f; and the hom of c(f,id_Y) followed by transport along comp_id f equals the hom of whiskerRight i(Y) L_f followed by leftUnitor L_f. This asserts only component equalities at K-flat representatives, not existence of i or equality on all derived objects.

source.place: Tag 0D5S, Cohomology Lemma 20.27.2; tensor mate unit laws in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.CompositionIso

proof.text: Transport the pinned tensor adjunctions along id_comp f and comp_id f by equality induction. Check on sections that pushforwardComp followed by this equality transport is the corresponding whiskering of pushforwardId and the functor unitor. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_comp_id and Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_id_comp. Map these equalities to complexes and the homotopy quotient; quotient_obj_surjective reduces the component identities to termwise identities. This is the proved private helper tensorPullback_homotopy_unit.

At the homotopy image H of P, transport the supplied counits along id_comp and comp_id. Expand hc and Functor.leftDerived_fac_app. Apply Qh to the two tensor mate identities from the preceding calculation, then substitute the normalization hi at T_f^h(H) and at H. Naturality of i X proves the first path equality after postcomposition with epsilon_f(H); naturality of epsilon_f and functoriality prove the second.

The assumption hK f P hP makes epsilon_f(H) invertible. Cancel this component as a monomorphism in both calculations; the functor unitor components are identities. No K-flatness of a tensor pullback, boundedness, descent, or resolution of any other object is needed.
